intro: Belarus has produced champions in tennis, biathlon and gymnastics.

chapters.title: Tennis
text: Aryna Sabalenka has become world number one and won several Grand Slam titles, and Victoria Azarenka won the Australian Open twice.

chapters.title: Winter sports
text: Biathlete Darya Domracheva won three Olympic golds in 2014. Since 2022 Belarusian teams have been banned from many international competitions because of the war in Ukraine.

keyTerms.meaning: Cross-country skiing combined with rifle shooting.
